conditions.pe_expressibility_note: housing_benefit_applicable_income nets off income_tax and national_insurance, and UC and Pension Credit income definitions read income tax, so the PA reform flows through without extra construction. HB parameters start 2015 and working-age HB is reported-anchored. Partial: separate age-related allowance machinery is absent (personal_allowance.py); this affects the tax change and downstream benefit response, beyond the separate dated-parameter gap.
conditions.pe_missing: No age/date-of-birth-related personal allowances or their separate income taper: personal_allowance computes one common amount and the GBP 100,000 ANI taper. Older taxpayers affected differently before 2016 cannot be represented by the common allowance reform.
